title: Great app!
body: Enjoy using it a lot. The only thing I would ask to make it perfect is to allow to log “multiple sessions”. For example, I brush my teeth and meditate twice a day, for 3/10 minutes each time, and it would be nice if I could log each session separately, not using one timer with “overall” time. Other than that - I am in love and do not regret buying lifetime pass.
author: A124kun
